Unresolved: the exact effective date within 2026, whether OAuth 2.1 remains current after the 2026 guide (no later snapshot is supplied), and any migration or grace-period details are not addressed by the sources. 'Current' therefore means current as of the supplied evidence, not a guarantee beyond it.
